stories.title: Assista ao Bom Dia Amapá desta sexta-feira (18)

en.title: Watch Bom Dia Amapá from Friday (18)
en.summary: G1 broadcasts local news programs daily, including Bom Dia Amapá at 7am, JAP1 at 11:45am, and JAP2 at 7:05pm.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja a agenda dos candidatos ao Governo do Maranhão nesta sexta-feira (18)

en.title: 2026 Elections: see the agenda of candidates for Governor of Maranhão on Friday (18)
en.summary: Eight candidates registered for Maranhão's 2026 gubernatorial election have begun campaign activities. G1 publishes daily the candidates' schedules as provided by their parties.

stories.title: Matrículas para a rede estadual de SP em 2027 terminam nesta sexta-feira (18); veja como fazer

en.title: Enrollments for São Paulo state schools in 2027 end on Friday (18); see how to apply
en.summary: The deadline for registration or transfer to São Paulo state schools for the 2027 school year expires on Friday. The process applies to approximately 5,000 state schools and new units built through public-private partnerships.

stories.title: Protesto interrompe parcialmente circulação de trens na linha 12-safira em SP

en.title: Protest partially interrupts train circulation on line 12-Sapphire in São Paulo
en.summary: Protesters on the tracks caused the CPTM's line 12-Sapphire to suspend service between São Miguel Paulista and Comendador Ermelino stations in eastern São Paulo on Friday morning.

stories.title: Protesto por moradia interrompe parcialmente circulação da Linha 12-Safira da CPTM em SP

en.title: Housing protest partially disrupts CPTM Line 12-Safira circulation in SP
en.summary: A housing protest in São Miguel Paulista, eastern São Paulo, partially halted train service on Line 12-Safira when unidentified individuals set fires on the tracks. Operations resumed within approximately one hour and forty minutes.

stories.title: Ataque a tiros em escola no sul das Filipinas mata ao menos duas pessoas

en.title: Shooting attack at school in southern Philippines kills at least two people
en.summary: At least two people died in a shooting attack at a school in southern Philippines on Friday. This marks the third such incident in the country since June.

stories.title: Ataque a tiros em escola no sul das Filipinas deixa mortos e feridos

en.title: Shooting attack at school in southern Philippines leaves dead and wounded
en.summary: A shooting attack occurred at a school in southern Philippines, resulting in deaths and injuries.

stories.title: Governo discutiu três cenários para o Bolsa Família e optou por reajuste mais amplo às vésperas da eleição

en.title: Government discussed three scenarios for Bolsa Família and opted for broader adjustment before election
en.summary: The Brazilian government considered multiple adjustment options for Bolsa Família but chose a linear benefit increase that benefits more recipients despite higher costs and lower technical efficiency.

stories.title: Notícia no Seu Tempo: Governo Lula anuncia aumento no Bolsa Família, a 17 dias da eleição

en.title: News in Your Time: Lula Government Announces Increase in Bolsa Família, 17 Days Before Election
en.summary: The Brazilian government announced an increase to the Bolsa Família social welfare program less than three weeks before the election.

stories.title: Vorcaro contratou ex-cunhado de Gilmar enquanto ministro decidia sobre faculdades privadas

en.title: Vorcaro Hired Ex-Brother-in-Law of Gilmar While Minister Decided on Private Colleges
en.summary: Francisco Feitosa, a former brother-in-law of Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes, was hired by businessman Daniel Vorcaro in 2024 while the minister was deciding matters related to private universities.

stories.title: Libertadores tem semifinais definidas com Palmeiras x Fluminense e Flamengo x Estudiantes

en.title: Libertadores has semifinals defined with Palmeiras vs Fluminense and Flamengo vs Estudiantes
en.summary: Flamengo secured a 1-1 draw against Independiente del Valle with nine players on the field and advanced to the Copa Libertadores semifinals alongside Palmeiras, Fluminense, and Estudiantes.

stories.title: Veja como foi a quinta-feira (17) dos candidatos a presidente

en.title: See How Thursday (17) Was for Presidential Candidates
en.summary: Presidential candidates carried out campaign activities on Thursday including walks, rallies, and visits to fairs and institutions across Brazil.

stories.title: J.P. Morgan abandona cenário-base para petróleo com guerra: “Não sabemos como modelar o desfecho”

en.title: J.P. Morgan Abandons Base Case for Oil with War: "We Don't Know How to Model the Outcome"
en.summary: J.P. Morgan ceased using its standard forecasting model for the oil market due to uncertainty surrounding the U.S.-Iran conflict, acknowledging inability to predict the outcome.

stories.title: Extremos climáticos na Amazônia exigem governança forte e preventiva

en.title: Extreme climate events in the Amazon require strong preventive governance
en.summary: Recent severe droughts in the Amazon between 2023 and 2024, linked to global climate crisis and El Niño, have caused record high temperatures and historically low river levels. A study indicates that current response capacity to such climate extremes in the region is insufficient.

stories.title: Vendas no varejo do Reino Unido aumentam 0,5% em agosto apesar da aceleração da inflação

en.title: UK retail sales rise 0.5% in August despite accelerating inflation
en.summary: United Kingdom retail sales recovered in August, driven by online sales growth and showing resilience amid rising inflation pressures.

stories.title: Preços ao produtor na Alemanha sobem 4,6% ao ano em agosto

en.title: German producer prices rise 4.6% annually in August
en.summary: German producer prices increased 4.6% year-over-year in August 2026, marking the fifth consecutive monthly rise and exceeding market forecasts of 4.1%.

stories.title: Bolsas asiáticas fecham em alta com impulso de Wall Street e queda do petróleo

en.title: Asian stock markets close higher on Wall Street rally and falling oil prices
en.summary: Asian stock exchanges mostly closed with gains on Friday, supported by a rally on Wall Street and declining oil prices.
